groups.title: Svelte Stores
groups.question: Your app's theme, cart and filtered product list are shared across many components. Explain how Svelte stores and context share state.

followUps.Writable and readable stores for shared: What is the difference between a writable and a readable store?
followUps.Derived stores that compute from other s: What does a derived store do?
followUps.Context API for component-tree scoped st: When would you use context instead of a module-level store?

evidence.text: Stores hold values that components subscribe to.
Writable stores can be updated from outside.
Readable stores can only be changed by their own logic.
A derived store computes its value from other stores.
It updates automatically when its sources change.
This replaces manual subscriptions and calculations.
setContext and getContext pass values down a component tree.
Context is local to that tree, while a module store is shared by the whole app.
On the server, module stores can leak state between users, which context avoids.

notEnough: Only saying context avoids prop drilling.

groups.title: Accessibility Patterns
groups.question: Svelte keeps warning about accessibility in your custom dropdown. Explain how you would fix it.

followUps.ARIA attributes and semantic HTML in com: How do semantic HTML and ARIA make components accessible?

evidence.text: Semantic elements like button give roles and keyboard support automatically.
ARIA attributes add meaning where HTML cannot, like aria-expanded.
Svelte's compile-time warnings point out missing attributes early.

groups.title: Transitions and Animations
groups.question: Your todo list feels abrupt when items appear, disappear or reorder. Explain Svelte's transitions and animations.

followUps.Built-in transitions like fade and slide: How do transitions like fade work?
followUps.The animate directive for list reorderin: What does animate:flip do in a list?

evidence.text: svelte/transition provides ready-made transitions like fade and slide.
Adding transition:fade animates elements when they are added and removed.
They work on elements inside if and each blocks.
animate:flip works on keyed each blocks.
Items slide smoothly to their new positions when the order changes.
No manual DOM measuring is needed.

groups.title: Actions and Use Directives
groups.question: You need to focus an input when it appears, integrate a third-party chart library and build a data table that works with any row type. Explain actions and generic components.

followUps.Custom actions for reusable DOM behavior: What is a Svelte action and when do you use one?
followUps.Reusable component patterns with generic: How do generic components keep a reusable table type-safe?

evidence.text: An action is a function attached to an element with use:.
It runs imperative DOM code when the element is created.
It can return cleanup logic for when the element is removed, which suits third-party libraries.
Svelte 5 components can declare a generic type parameter.
One table component works with any item type.
TypeScript still checks the props for each use.

notEnough: Only saying components can be generic.
